Name: Mammoth Mountain

SnowReport.Report:
Thursday, November 12, 2026 6:00 AM  –  Bluebird skies and barely a breeze make for a crisp, quiet start to Thursday. Broadway Express (1) and the Lower Panorama Gondola are expected to spin from 8:30 AM to 4 PM today, conditions permitting. Groomers start firm and fast this morning, then soften as the day goes. Early season obstacles exist, so please ski and ride with caution. Visit the Ski School front desk for information on lesson offerings. For unlimited access to ski and ride all season long, grab your Ikon Pass today!

Conditions and Visibility:   Sunny skies and light southwest winds are expected today, with temperatures climbing into the mid 40s. Groomers will start out firm and fast before softening in the afternoon sun. Grab a dark lens for the bright light.
Lift Status: Broadway Express (1) and the Lower Panorama Gondola are expected, providing access to Broadway, Silver Tip, and Rusty's. No beginner terrain is available.
Safety:   If it's marked, it matters. Early-season obstacles exist throughout the mountain, so please respect all signs, ropes, and closures, and keep an eye out for unmarked obstacles. Be sure to maintain at least 15 feet of space between yourself and other skiers and riders so everyone has room to turn and stop. Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is: 760.934.0611
Road Conditions: Always be prepared for winter mountain driving and watch for icy patches in shaded areas. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest status.

ParkingAreasDescription:
PARKING OPTIONS
All lots typically open at 6:00 AM. Overnight parking is prohibited in Mammoth lots, but is allowed downhill from Shuttle Stop B and further along HWY 203 on the ski area side, at owner's risk during the summer months. Shared bear lockers are available. Please do not leave food or scented items in your vehicle overnight. No overnight camping is allowed.

PREFERRED PARKING | PAID
Preferred Parking is available at Main Lodge on a first-come, first-served basis. Preferred Parking offers easy access to your vehicle throughout the day. Look for the white-and-black "Preferred Parking" signs and the parking attendant who will take your payment. Your parking space will not be reserved for you if you leave.

GENERAL PARKING | FREE
Each base lodge (Main, Canyon, and Eagle) offers parking areas free of charge. There are also free parking lots available at Chair 4 and Chair 2 (The Mill), and along HWY 203.

BIKE PARK SHUTTLE
Offers free transportation service between The Village and Main Lodge on a space-available basis, leaving The Village from stop #90 (on Canyon Blvd.) on the quarter from 9:00 AM–5:30 PM. The last shuttle leaves Main Lodge at 5:10 PM and The Village at 5:30 PM. Priority is given to Bike Park riders, and a valid bike park ticket is required to transport a bicycle.

SnowReport.Report:
We are open for the 2026/27 Season!

As A-Basin celebrates its 80th anniversary this winter, the ski area will mark the occasion
with a season-long celebration of the people and culture that have shaped The Legend for
generations. While much has changed over eight decades, the spirit of A-Basin remains the
same.

All season long, join us in celebrating nearly a century of fantastic skiing and riding with
events, deals, giveaways, and more.

80-Year-Olds Ski Free – You’ve been with us this whole time. So, in celebration of A-Basin's
legacy and yours, anyone who is 80 years old can ski free every Wednesday of the 2026/27
winter season, plus our birthday weekend (December 5-6).
$80 Lift Tickets - Snag a limited edition $80 ticket every Wednesday of the 26/27 winter as
well as our birthday weekend (December 5-6) to celebrate this historic season with us!
*$50 early & late season
Legendary 80 Scan Challenge – For the first 80 days of the season, each day you scan
your A-Basin or Ikon Pass, you are entered to win 80 different prizes including a grand prize
of a trip to Mike Wiegele Helicopter Skiing.

December 4-6 Birthday Celebration – Join us all weekend long as an ode to a journey
that’s 80 years in the making, and toasting to many more to come. Not mandatory but
highly encouraged all weekend long: Decades & vintage themed ski wear.

Friday, Dec 4
  • Uphill n’ Chill (on sale soon)
Saturday, Dec 5
  • Free ski & snowboard demo village in Mountain Goat Plaza
  • Afternoon live DJ in Mountain Goat Plaza
  • 80th Anniversary Moonlight Dinner at Black Mountain Lodge (on sale soon)
    • Skin, snowshoe, or ride the lift up under the stars for a multi-course meal and legendary celebration.
    • Premiere of A-Basin's 80th Anniversary short film
    • Burying of A-Basin time capsule
Sunday, Dec 6
• Free ski & snowboard demo village in Mountain Goat Plaza and prizes and
giveaways at the Lenawee ExpressFind more information on the 80th anniversary and our entire events calendar at
https://www.arapahoebasin.com/events/
